description: This file contains unit tests for the LoopGuard utility class in the org.apache.fineract.util package. It verifies the behavior of safe do-while and while loops with respect to maximum iteration limits and loop execution logic.

classes.name: LoopGuardTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for testing the LoopGuard mechanisms such as safe do-while and while loops in the context of iteration limits.

classes.name: TestContext
classes.description: Inner static class implementing LoopContext interface, used as the context object in loop tests, tracking iteration count.

methods.name: testSafeDoWhileLoopExecutesCorrectly
methods.description: Parameterized test verifying that the safe do-while loop executes the correct number of times up to the target value within max iterations.

methods.name: testSafeWhileLoopExecutesCorrectly
methods.description: Parameterized test verifying that the safe while loop executes the correct number of times up to the target value within max iterations.

methods.name: testSafeDoWhileLoopThrowsOnExceedingMaxIterations
methods.description: Test that asserts IllegalStateException is thrown if the do-while loop exceeds max iterations.

methods.name: testSafeWhileLoopThrowsOnExceedingMaxIterations
methods.description: Test that asserts IllegalStateException is thrown if the while loop exceeds max iterations.

methods.name: testSafeDoWhileLoopRunsAtLeastOnce
methods.description: Test ensuring that the do-while loop executes at least once even if the condition is false initially.

methods.name: testSafeWhileLoopSkipsIfConditionFalseInitially
methods.description: Test ensuring that the while loop does not execute if the initial condition is false.
